answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using trust-graph bottleneck routing. Honest nodes harbor bounded credit links, creating a topological haven where random walks rarely traverse sparse cuts into adversarial clusters. This forces an attacker to obtain scarce, authentic peer endorsements instead of fabricating virtual identities. A reputation mesa caps aggregate weight regardless of adversary cluster size. However, cold-start friction severely penalizes new, legitimate agents.
